name: The Voice of Arvid (megagame)
text: At the start of the agenda phase, you may look at the top 5 cards of the agenda deck. Choose 1 and immediately resolve it as if you had cast 1 vote for an outcome of your choice; discard the rest. Then, purge this card.
notes: Megagame ruling: prepared and resolved during the action phase; no whens or afters, no window for Confounding Disclosure and no Committee Formation; the chosen agenda resolves straight away.
